issues.problem: NEET does not test an 'intensity versus frequency' graph. The standard graphs are photocurrent vs intensity, photocurrent vs collector potential (for different intensities and frequencies), and stopping potential vs frequency. Students may look for a graph type that does not exist.
issues.correction: mostly on the photoelectric equation, stopping potential, photocurrent–potential and stopping potential–frequency graphs, photon momentum and de Broglie wavelength comparisons
